description:
Check an email address an agent is about to store, email or trust: syntax, disposable / throwaway provider, role account, free webmail. Free tier (no network). For MX, mail auth, domain age and a verdict (valid | risky | undeliverable) use the paid x402 endpoint /v1/email.

[DomainCheck via YourAITools MCP Hub] Free tier: same as DomainCheck's own MCP server (call without payment and without tier). Paid: email $0.001 per call, with a credits key (Authorization: Bearer yatc_...) or x402 (USDC; the hub returns the payment terms). Failed tool calls aren't charged: credits are refunded automatically and x402 payments only settle on success.

tier.description: Paid tier: email $0.001. Omit tier (with no credits key or x402 payment) to use the free tier.
